findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:60` defines `mapPointsFunctor {H K} (φ : H ⟶ K)` and its `naturality` proof at lines 65-67 is exactly the general value-algebra naturality square; the PR instead proves only `mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint` at `HopfIdealPointsNaturality.lean:108-133`.
findings.fix: Add a general lemma in the `CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor` API, e.g. `HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ ((mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f) = (mapPointsFunctor φ).app B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := K) χ f)`, then derive the quotient/lift statement from the specialization `φ = mkQuotient H I` and `quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint`.
findings.issue: `mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint` is a quotient-specific element-chase for naturality in the value algebra, while the same square is already natural for every coordinate morphism `φ : H ⟶ K`.

summary: The quotient subgroup restriction is at the right Hopf-ideal level, but the value-algebra naturality lemma is proved only for the quotient lift instead of exposing the existing general coordinate-morphism naturality first.
